description: Tiers of the Rust test binaries. See scripts/test-tiers.mjs and docs/development.md.
measuredFrom: cargo test --workspace on the integration stack, one build job, two test threads (the coordinator's run of 2026-11-20); a binary with "unmeasured" was added after it. Binaries that failed in that run are timed as they ran; record again after a green run with: node scripts/test-tiers.mjs times <log> --write

tests.reason: aggregate_copies: Stored aggregate results with a fixed-seed property over random schemas, roles and writes on an in-process backend; scoped runs include it when the backend, the kernel's audience or aggregates modules, or a store changed; approvals: Approval steps, compensation, the invoke-operation step and the direct start of a run through the worker on the in-memory store; not yet measured; audit_log: Audit entries of role and configuration changes, and the verify-audit-chain route on a tampered trail, on the in-memory store; not yet measured; ledger_trigger: The ledger-trigger fixture product end to end on real sockets: install, ledger postings, the worker and reads as members; not yet measured; dispatch: The mail dispatcher through the worker on the in-memory store: a segment of 150 members and every send of each test run through worker passes; files: Added after the last measured run and not yet measured; full until a green run records its time; inbox: Not yet measured: the inbox on real sockets, including a send to a segment of 205 members that three worker jobs finish; full tier until it is measured; keycloak: The OpenID Connect authorization code flow against a live Keycloak container (STRATA_IDP=1 node scripts/containers.mjs up); needs STRATA_KEYCLOAK_URL, and fails naming it when unset; not yet measured; ledger_more: expiry jobs with a retried lease, batches of a hundred accounts, verification of a tampered header and a ledger per tenant; outbound: Added after the last measured run and not yet measured; full until a green run records its time; quota: Starts running backends on real sockets and logs in with Argon2 (the quotas, plans, flags and the usage route); resident_sealed: The working set below the sealed store: a key destroyed through a second handle reads back as the erased token, a commit naming a new subject does not conflict, no resident key holds a personal value, and the storage conformance suite runs through it on the memory adapter and SQLite; sealing: The sealed store through the backend: sealing, erasure, restore, replay and the audit chain on SQLite, with key derivation in every seal; search: Added after the last measured run and not yet measured; full until a green run records its time; segment_jobs: Runs the worker over a segment of 350 people, its refresh, its event log, a fan-out and a bundle install, on the in-memory store; service: The backend as a running service on real sockets (60 tests); scoped runs include it when the backend or anything under it changed; startup: Runs the real backend binary with a bare environment and checks each refused start names its variable; not yet measured; subject_rights: Subject export, restriction, legal holds and the retention sweep, each on the memory store and SQLite, with the worker running the jobs; scoped runs include it when the backend or the kernel changed
process: Runs the real gateway binary: refused starts, and on Unix SIGTERM draining it within its deadline

The generated contract conformance suite (WG-5182): one test per shipped contract with a bffRoute, run on one shared backend (in-memory SQLite) and BFF whose development accounts sign in once; the contracts that end sessions or change factors, and the two quotas, start a stack of their own
The self-test of the conformance suite: a stand-in server per fixture contract, nine of whose tests must fail

corpus: Compiles the 14 enterprise product files with specc, installs them into one tenant, and populates the small scale three times (twice on the memory store, once on SQLite, plus another seed) to check that a fixed seed gives a byte-identical tenant hash on both stores, and only plans the large scale
rule_reads: Four tests over the notes world with one schema change and one posting or setting write each; not yet measured

approvals: not yet measured; audience: Audience classes with a fixed-seed property over random schemas, roles and records; scoped runs include it when the kernel's audience or aggregates modules changed; ledger_policies: random credits, debits and expiries from a fixed seed, and a tenant of ten thousand account limits; search: Added after the last measured run and not yet measured; full until a green run records its time

simulation: Determinism and minimisation over the Fieldnotes bundle, and the shell path with each fault of the failure modes, which share one fault-free baseline run; scoped runs include it when the simulation crate or a tenant bundle changed

bundle: Not yet measured: loads the platform specification and runs specc; full tier until it is measured; conformance: Loads the platform specification and formats its whole generated conformance suite with rustfmt; not yet measured; golden: Regenerates three fixture crates and compares them byte for byte; scoped runs include it when the specc crate changed; layers: Validates the whole specification with Exegra three times (the accepted products together in one project, and each of two refused products) and runs specc over the whole specification twice per generated tree; strata_differential: Steps every generated machine, Rust and JavaScript, through every scenario trace from Exegra
sealed: The sealed store over the memory adapter: the whole conformance suite run through it

postgres: Needs STRATA_PG_URL, a PostgreSQL server whose role may create databases, and fails without it; the tiers cannot state an environment requirement, so it is not in the routine tier beside the SQLite conformance test. Its test is #[ignore]d, so the full tier reports it as ignored unless run with --ignored. Runs the whole conformance suite with a fresh database per case

durability: SQLite crash, upgrade and many-tenant cases; scoped runs include it when a storage crate changed; fleet: SQLite tenant files on disk, one of them marked as migrated by a newer version, run through the fleet migration; ledger_limits: upgrades a tenant file whose schema held the limits of accounts, which needs the older layout rebuilt; query_plan_scale: Planned reads and views over 100,000 records on SQLite and the memory store; measured 1432 s in the routine run of 2026-11-20, far past the routine budget; sealed_index: SQLite files on disk, opened by a second connection to read the record index and the schema history; search: Added after the last measured run and not yet measured; full until a green run records its time

exegra: Replays one scenario of each kind (the machines it runs and the kinds of its faults) through Exegra, in one process per shard, and steps the generated system host through it; the one comparison that needs them
correspondence: Runs the Lean build and compares it with the kernel, including 200 seeded random sequences through one Lean process (needs lake); the gate also runs lake build
